StudentAccount.title: Student Account
StudentAccount.description: Private authenticated student profile containing selected class level, syllabus board (CBSE, ICSE, State Board, etc.), subjects, learning goal, daily study pace, and study timetable.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

classLevel.description: Selected academic class or grade level.

syllabus.description: Selected curriculum board or syllabus (e.g., CBSE, ICSE, State Board, IB, IGCSE).

language.description: Preferred study language (e.g., English, Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Spanish, etc.).

subjects.description: Bounded list of 1 to 8 selected subjects.

timetable.description: Optional bounded weekly study timetable entries (0 to 28 slots).

completedDates.description: Optional bounded list of unique YYYY-MM-DD local calendar dates on which the student completed at least one learning module (0 to 365 dates).

subscription.description: Student subscription state tracking the 1-month (30-day) free trial, the 7-year ₹200 INR Scholar Pass, and optional ₹0 referral/discount code (PRINCE) redemption.

reminders.description: Student study notification preferences including daily study reminder time (HH:MM), sound chime, browser alert preference, and up to 20 scheduled topic completion reminders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

SubjectPathRecord.title: Subject Learning Path
SubjectPathRecord.description: Specialized learning path for a single subject belonging to an authenticated student.

subjectKey.description: Normalized URL-safe document identifier for the subject.

overview.description: Short curriculum summary for the subject.

focusStrategy.description: Recommended study approach for this subject.

adaptationNote.description: Optional student preference note used to tailor the path.

generatedByAi.description: Whether this path was generated by the AI curriculum planner.

modules.description: Bounded list of 1 to 8 staged learning modules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject path was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject path was last updated.

TutorThreadRecord.title: Subject AI Tutor Thread
TutorThreadRecord.description: Bounded Socratic AI tutor conversation history for a specific student subject.

messages.description: Bounded list of up to 40 tutor conversation messages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was updated.

YouTubeClassRecord.title: YouTube Class & Quiz Record
YouTubeClassRecord.description: Saved YouTube study class with generated and student-added quiz questions in the student's chosen language.

classId.description: Normalized URL-safe document identifier for the saved YouTube class.

subject.description: Academic subject linked to the video class.

language.description: Language used for the class summary and quiz questions.

summary.description: Concise summary of the YouTube class.

keyTakeaways.description: Bounded list of up to 8 key takeaways from the class.

questions.description: Bounded list of up to 60 AI-generated and student-added quiz questions.

bestQuizScore.description: Optional best quiz score percentage (0 to 100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the YouTube class was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the YouTube class or its questions were updated.

/students/{userId}.description: Private student account document storing class level, syllabus board, preferred language, subjects, goal, daily study pace, study streak dates, and study timetable.

/students/{userId}/subjectPaths/{subject.description: Per-subject specialized learning paths, notes, short notes, shortcuts, quizzes, and module mastery progress for a student.

/students/{userId}/tutorThreads/{subject.description: Per-subject bounded AI study tutor conversation history for a student.

/students/{userId}/youtubeClasses/{class.description: Saved YouTube classes with generated and custom-added quiz questions in the student's chosen language.
